name: Animal Kingdom Thrill Rides
intro: Animal Kingdom is deceptively thrilling for a park that bills itself on nature. It has one of the best roller coasters on property, the most technically ambitious simulator Disney has ever built, and a river rapids that takes no prisoners. These four are the ones to plan your day around.

rides.blurb: The undisputed centerpiece of the park and arguably the best theme park attraction in the world. Book Lightning Lane Single Pass before park open or expect 90+ minute waits — worth every minute of either.

A proper steel coaster at 50 mph with a backward section and genuine vertical drop. Use the single-rider line if your group doesn't mind splitting up; it's consistently the fastest way into the mountain.
Skip this on cold mornings, ride it on hot afternoons — a 20-foot drop in a spinning 12-person raft through a lushly themed conflict that ends with at least one person absolutely soaked.

Not a thrill ride in the traditional sense, but the unpredictability of real animals at close range — a lion walking the road, hippos surfacing at the wrong moment — creates excitement no animatronic can match.
